name: New York New Year 2023
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. All competitors must read the COVID Safety tab before registering, as proof of full vaccination or a negative test will be required. **Competitors may bring at most one guest.** Please note that this competition will take place from **4pm** on New Year's Eve (December 31, 2022) to **2am** on New Year's Day (January 1, 2023).
